description: collect_two_string_lists and collect_one_string_list build intermediate Vec<Vec<&str>> on every test evaluation. For hot mail filters that evaluate thousands of messages per second, these allocations add up. The function walks all forms into a Vec<Vec<_>> and then indexes [0] and [1]. A streaming approach that returns (first_list, second_list) without the outer Vec would avoid one allocation level. Impact: modest on small scripts; visible under profiler for high-volume SMTP filters.
title: sieve: collect_two_string_lists always collects all forms into Vec<Vec<str>>; Vec alloc per test
